significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) predictive and dose-response law: a "compact feature set whose activation on generated tokens predicts which sequences transmit," while clamping it "monotonically increases or removes the trait acquired by the student." This establishes both a phenomenon—sequence-level feature activity predicts later transmission—and a causal mechanism that constrains expectations across clamp magnitudes and trait-feature swaps, rather than merely showing that a representation exists; this would directly sharpen the hidden-signal account underlying Cloud et al.'s 2025 subliminal-learning results and the feature-intervention paradigm represented by Cunningham et al. (2023) and Bricken et al. (2023). Verified false would distinguishably rule out the stated compact, SAE-addressable causal account, although it would not rule out a diffuse channel or a representation missed by the SAE, so the negative branch is useful but not decisive about all mechanisms. In the topic-substitution check, merely restating "extend research on subliminal learning" would not earn this score; the claim-specific predictive coupling and monotonic causal relation make it more constraining than the topic's obvious first mechanism hypothesis.

reach.justification: The named handles are feature activity that "predicts, per sequence, the amount of trait the sequence transmits" and a generation-side intervention where "suppressing the features removes the trait while amplifying them strengthens it." These are ex ante handles because prediction and clamping occur while curating or generating distillation data, before the student acquires the trait, giving auditors or model developers an action window rather than only a post-hoc explanation. The claim predicts that re-extraction should recover a compact feature set with the same predictive and monotonic relation across traits and neutral formats such as "numbers/code," but it does not assert transfer across architectures and explicitly allows layer- and width-specificity, limiting the conclusion below broad generality. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: subliminal learning alone supplies neither a screening quantity nor a generation-time control, whereas these claim-specific handles could be used by practitioners who audit or run distillation.
